_doc: The harnesses agents run in. Names are what run_remote_control.sh, variants and attempts store. Server/internal/harness embeds a copy (harnesses.json beside it) and its test asserts the copy equals this file; supervisor and frontend read this file. `capabilities.steward` is yes, no or conditional (steward-capable only where a host check passes). `settings` lists the typed settings a variant or harness config may hold: kind is model, provider or enum (options in display order). Adding a harness: add it here and copy the file; the API enums and the database lookup table follow.
